digest.component_or_area: CloudWatch monitoring alarms, Terraform infrastructure code
propositions: rebar-gerrit-voter-errors alarm transitions OK to ALARM but declares no alarm_actions or ok_actions, so it fires silently and operators are never notified
rebar-gerrit-replication-errors alarm has the identical defect: no alarm_actions, causing silent failures identical to voter_errors

Eleven of thirteen aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm resources in infra/terraform/ follow the convention of wiring alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn; voter_errors and replication_errors are the only two outliers
When the voter fails closed, changes become unsubmittable (per ADR-0013) and this silence is a production safety gap during the Bedrock cutover ordering criterion

A guard test must parse every aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm block in infra/terraform/ and fail on any lacking alarm_actions, with an anti-vacuity assertion that at least 13 alarms are found and an explicit opt-out marker required for intentional silence
